```python
from pocket_coffea.lib.cuts import MultiCut, CartesianCut
from pocket_coffea.parameters.cuts import Cut

# Jet multiplicity bins using JetGood collection
jet_bins = MultiCut([
    ("4j", Cut("nJetGood == 4")),
    ("5j", Cut("nJetGood == 5")),
    ("6j+", Cut("nJetGood >= 6")),
])

# B-tag multiplicity bins
btag_bins = MultiCut([
    ("2b", Cut("nBTag == 2")),
    ("3b+", Cut("nBTag >= 3")),
])

# Create cartesian product of analysis categories
analysis_categories = CartesianCut([jet_bins, btag_bins])
```
